description: This file defines a custom exception class called StartupException used in the org.apache.ofbiz.base.start package to indicate issues during startup processes.

classes.name: StartupException
classes.description: A final class extending Exception, used for signaling startup errors in the OFBiz framework. It provides constructors for different use cases and overrides getMessage() to include nested cause message if present.

methods.name: StartupException()
methods.description: Default constructor that creates a new StartupException without a detail message.

methods.name: StartupException(String msg)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new StartupException with a specified detail message.

methods.name: StartupException(String msg, Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new StartupException with a specified message and nested exception.

methods.name: StartupException(Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new StartupException with a nested cause.

methods.name: getMessage()
methods.description: Overrides the getMessage method to include the cause's message if present.

methods.name: getNonNestedMessage()
methods.description: Returns the exception's message without including nested cause information.
